title.narrative: Increased access to education with a focus on providing better opportunities for girls, children with disabilities, and excluded children. (STG and GEA)

description.narrative:
Increased Access to Inclusive and Equitable Education The programme has significantly expanded access to education, with a strong emphasis on reaching girls, children with disabilities, and other marginalized groups. Through targeted interventions under the STG and GEA frameworks, the following key achievements have been realized:
Improved Enrolment: There has been a notable increase in gross enrolment rates for both girls and boys, including pastoralist children and learners with disabilities across target counties. Enhanced Grade Completion and Transition: A growing proportion of girls supported by the programme are successfully completing their grade levels and transitioning to the next, reflecting improved retention and progression. Expanded School Infrastructure: More schools in target counties now offer full-cycle primary education, ensuring continuity and reducing dropout rates. Safe and Supportive Learning Environments: Investments in infrastructure and child protection have led to the creation of physically safe learning spaces that promote both academic achievement and well-being. Shifting Social Norms: There is evidence of positive change in community attitudes towards gender equality, with increasing support for equitable roles and norms. Improved Perceptions of Safety: A higher share of students and teachers report feeling safe both on their journey to school and within the school environment, contributing to better attendance and learning outcomes.
